opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for member engagement at Society meetings and Society-sponsored events, covering conference registration and a contribution toward travel and accommodation (up to three meetings per application).

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact in physiology.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives and members; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers (members of The Physiological Society) who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, e.g. for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship, or other fully justified sundries.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of equity, diversity and inclusion in the physiological sciences (teaching or research).
